title: mirrortimer
summary: Benilla ships the three reference mirror-timer bars (breath/fatigue/feign-death) driven by SMSG_START/PAUSE/STOP_MIRROR_TIMER through the MIRROR_TIMER_* FrameXML events with client-side value+rate integration. MSUIClient has nothing: a repo-wide grep for MIRROR finds no opcode, no decoder, and no bar UI. Swimming underwater produces no breath bar and no drowning warning surface.

openItems.text: SMSG_START_MIRROR_TIMER / SMSG_PAUSE_MIRROR_TIMER / SMSG_STOP_MIRROR_TIMER not in Opcodes.cs and never decoded
No mirror-timer bar UI (colored StatusBar + label + border under the top-center of the screen)
No client-side countdown integration (value + signed rate per tick)
